Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1345
Claimant:
Leonard Reed
Adjuster:
Valerie Rodriguez
6-9-23
First notice of loss received from the claimant reporting a low-speed head-on collision at a residential intersection.
The claimant reports neck and back strain and is not represented by an attorney.
8-4-23
Confirmed the driver is listed on the policy as a named driver and that coverage was in force at the time of the loss.
Nothing in the file suggests the vehicle damage predates the policy start.
8-29-23
Obtained the police report, which places the claimant in the vehicle at the scene. Statements from two independent
witnesses and the other driver describe the collision in the same sequence as the claimant.
9-2-23
Reviewed scene photos. The vehicle damage is largely consistent with the described impact speed and direction, and
no earlier damage to the vehicle is on record.
9-26-23
Spoke with the claimant by phone about the injury. The account matched the first notice of loss in every detail, and
the reported neck and back strain is a plausible result of a collision of this type.
11-19-23
Claimant referred to a primary care porvider for evaluation and started a standard course of physical therapy.
Treatment notes show steady improvement and a gradual reduction in visits.
11-27-23
Checked prior claims and medical history. No earlier injury to the neck or back has been identified, and the claimant
has not reported any other recent accidents.
1-9-24
Treatment has tapered off as the claimant has improved, consistent with the expected recovery timeline for this type
of soft tissue injury. File remains open pending final medical update.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
